description: Add a webhook to your GrowSurf program. `payloadUrl` is required. `events` is the list of events this webhook is subscribed to. Omit it to subscribe the webhook to every event its program type offers, or send `[]` for none. An event the program type does not offer returns `400`. A program can have up to 5 webhooks, counting the primary webhook, so you can create up to 4. Creating another returns `400`. `secret` is write-only — GrowSurf uses it to sign deliveries (the GrowSurf-Signature HMAC header) and never returns it. A program can have only one saved Bask Health webhook across all `bask.ninja` hosts and paths, including disabled webhooks. A second Bask Health webhook returns `400`. A concurrent change to webhook settings can return `409`; reload the webhooks before retrying. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_create_campaign_webhook

outputSchema.description: The created webhook. Same shape as the items in the `growsurf_list_campaign_webhooks` result.
